body:
# M A W – Technical Vanilla Enhanced
In this modpack, you'll enjoy an enhanced technical Minecraft experience focused on performance, optimization, and quality-of-life improvements.

Rather than adding new items or mechanics, this modpack upgrades the core vanilla gameplay with powerful tools and performance mods

![A few mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c92746d3872659f552df09adcf02118d3666fe4f_0.webp)

## Some of the included mods are:
**Carpet** – for advanced mechanics and rule customization

**Litematica** – for planning and building with schematics

**Sodium**, **Extra Sodium**, **Entity Culling**, **ModernFix**, and many more — all focused on boosting FPS and reducing lag.

This pack is **ideal for low-end PCs**, **offering** **high** **performance** and **compatibility** across a **wide** **range** **of** **systems**. Whether you're designing redstone contraptions, optimizing farms, or just want a **smoother** **vanilla** **experience**, Experiment 404 is built to run fast and feel responsive — without changing what you love about Minecraft.

As shown here, even low-spec machines can reach over **120** **FPS** **without** a dedicated **GPU**.
![As shown here, even low-spec machines can reach over 120 FPS without a dedicated GPU.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4a92d02654c395699424f2e3b29745de8837bd0.png)
No new items. No overcomplication. Just pure technical power — optimized.
